policy.primary: One main category and one main topic per retained record; uncertain assignments stay retained and are flagged.
policy.secondary: Up to two additional topic tags; coverage statistics default to exclusive primary labels.
policy.minimum_note: 200 per category and 30 per topic are adjustable starter-library coverage targets, not an estimate of field output or quality.
